documentation.what_this_is: Every defective strut found in 210127_Brian_Tran_strut_lattices_0point5dash1 1 Slices. 1822 defective of 18468 design struts (9.87%). Present struts are not listed here.
documentation.coordinates: p0/p1 are the two ends of the strut in SCAN VOXEL coordinates, ordered [x, y, z]. z is the TIF slice number, so z_slice_range tells you which slices to open. *_um fields are the same points in microns (1 voxel = 58.1 um).

defect_definitions.missing: no strut was built between the two nodes
defect_definitions.disconnected: a strut was built but is severed - no single connected piece of metal reaches from one node to the other
defect_definitions.thin: some sustained section is thinner than 197 um (healthy struts measure ~329 um)
defect_definitions.bent: the strut's centreline bows more than 212 um off the straight line between its own ends

subtype_definitions.dropped: both endpoint nodes were printed - the strut itself is absent
subtype_definitions.node_lost: one endpoint node was never printed, so the strut has nothing to span to
subtype_definitions.void: both endpoint nodes were never printed (an unprinted region)

node_states.junction: a real printed junction is there
node_states.partial: some metal is there but not a clean junction
node_states.absent: nothing was printed at that node position

documentation.region_warning: region=interior means >=35 voxels inside the printed lattice AND clear of the fused end-caps - these are the individually defensible defects. region=boundary means near an outer face, where the design extends past what was actually printed; the metal really is missing/severed there, but it reflects the under-built shell rather than an isolated defect. Quote interior counts for verified defects.

reading_the_measurements.gap_um: longest stretch with no metal within 8 voxels of the strut
reading_the_measurements.surviving_piece_um: longest continuous piece of strut mid-span; >212 um means material was built here, so the strut is disconnected not missing
reading_the_measurements.diameter_thinnest_um: thinnest sustained section (drives the thin verdict)
reading_the_measurements.bow_um: sustained deviation of the centreline from its own chord
reading_the_measurements.graph_hops: shortest path in hops between the two nodes through the as-built skeleton; >=2 independently confirms no direct connection, -1 means a node is not in the graph
reading_the_measurements.detached_at_joint: true = the strut body is still lying in place but is cracked off at a joint (break may read ~0 because the crack is short, yet the metal is not connected)
reading_the_measurements.metal_profile: 60 samples from p0 to p1; '#' = metal found within 8 voxels, '.' = nothing
